content.tagline: SENIOR SOFTWARE // HIGH-RELIABILITY SYSTEMS // SHIPPED PRODUCTS
content.bio: Eight-plus years building software in high-reliability environments. My full career is in payments: POS terminal applications, ISO8583 financial messaging, cryptography and mission-critical Android products. I apply that same discipline — architecture, security, traceability and production releases — as an expert building any kind of application. Proof in production: TerraLiam, a family outdoor game with maps, camera and AI, official web and ops panel; and App MiDoc, a mobile clinical platform for patients, doctors and administrators. Flutter, Dart, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue, Supabase and Firebase.

services.mobileText: iOS and Android apps with Flutter: maps, camera, auth, notifications, media and store release. The same rigor as a mission-critical system, applied to your product.
services.fullstackText: Official site and the panel to run the product: users, content, roles, metrics and publishing. Next.js or Vue, with Supabase or Firebase.
services.productText: App + web + backend. From concept to release: architecture, UI, APIs, privacy, CI/CD and real operations. TerraLiam and App MiDoc are the standard I apply.

faq.a1: QuintanaDev is Juniors Quintana's studio: a senior software engineer in Caracas. A career in high-reliability payment systems and his own digital products.
faq.q2: What kind of software do you build?
faq.a2: Any product that needs an app, a website and a backoffice. TerraLiam and App MiDoc are in production: a family game with maps and AI, and a mobile clinical platform for patients, doctors and administrators.
